content.user_title: Configure Better Auth Email Password Security
content.value_statement: Email and password authentication can fail when verification, reset flows, and password rules are incomplete. This skill guides safe Better Auth configuration with focused examples.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to enable Better Auth email and password authentication.
Shows where to configure verification and reset email handlers.
Describes required email verification for email and password sign-ins.
Covers reset token expiry, session revocation, and password length settings.
Compares default scrypt hashing with a custom Argon2id configuration.
Warns about migration risk when changing password hashing algorithms.
limitations: It does not implement a real email provider or delivery service.
It does not cover OAuth, passkeys, or multi-factor authentication.
It does not validate settings against a live Better Auth installation.
It gives migration guidance, but it does not automate password hash migration.

use_cases.title: Secure New Auth Setup
use_cases.description: Set up email login with verification, password rules, and callback URL guidance before launch.

use_cases.title: Password Reset Review
use_cases.description: Add reset emails, token expiry, and session revocation to an existing Better Auth project.

use_cases.title: Hashing Policy Planning
use_cases.description: Evaluate custom password hashing options and identify migration risks before changing production auth.

prompt_templates.title: Start Email Login
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to enable Better Auth email and password login with email verification. Show the server settings and client sign-up flow.

prompt_templates.title: Add Password Reset
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to add a password reset flow. Include the reset email handler, reset request, redirect target, and user-safe response guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Tighten Password Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Better Auth emailAndPassword settings. Recommend password length, reset token expiry, session revocation, and email verification changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Hash Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to evaluate switching Better Auth password hashing to Argon2id. Explain configuration needs, migration risk, and rollout checks.

output_examples.input: I need email verification for new sign-ups.
output: Enable an email verification handler in Better Auth.
Send a verification message with the provided verification URL.
Require verification before email and password sign-in when stricter security is needed.
Test sign-up and confirm that the verification email is triggered.

output_examples.input: Users need password reset without account enumeration.
output_examples.output: The response should stay consistent whether the email exists or not. Configure a reset email handler, set a short token lifetime, and revoke sessions after reset.

output_examples.input: I want to use Argon2id for password hashing.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends defining custom hash and verify functions, choosing Argon2id options, and planning migration for users with existing hashes.

best_practices: Use absolute callback and redirect URLs for sign-up, sign-in, and reset flows.
Require email verification before email and password sign-in when account trust matters.
Use short reset token lifetimes and revoke sessions after a successful password reset.
anti_patterns: Relying only on client-side validation for password requirements.
Logging reset links, reset tokens, or user email addresses in routine logs.
Changing password hashing algorithms without a migration plan.

faq.question: Does this skill enable Better Auth email and password login?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains the settings needed to enable email and password authentication.

faq.question: Does it cover email verification?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows where to send verification emails and how to require verification before sign-in.

faq.question: Does it cover password reset security?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers reset email handlers, token expiry, consistent responses, and session revocation.

faq.question: Does it provide a real email service integration?
faq.answer: No. It assumes the project already has an email sending function or provider.

faq.question: Can it help with custom password hashing?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes default scrypt hashing and shows how to configure a custom Argon2id approach.

faq.question: Can it safely migrate existing password hashes?
faq.answer: It warns about migration risk, but it does not provide an automated hash migration system.
